df_native = pd.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3],
    "jan": [100, 200, 300],
    "feb": [150, 250, 350],
    "mar": [200, 300, 400]
})

df = nw.from_native(df_native)

# Reshape from wide to long format
df_long = df.unpivot(
    on=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
    index="id",

    value_name="sales"
)

import narwhals as nw

    "id": [1, 2, 3],

    "mar": [200, 300, 400]
})

    on=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
    index="id",
